principles: Do not describe a figure as compensation due, claim value, amount owed or guaranteed redress.
Separate verified user input, derived agreement figures, assumed or missing information, lender-only information and official lender calculations.
Where commission is unknown, generate no monetary redress range.
Where verified commission information exists, show it as known commission information only unless the lender has provided an official redress calculation.

redressModes.label: No reliable commission information
redressModes.publicExplanation: A reliable monetary estimate cannot be calculated because commission arrangements and lender calculations are not known.

redressModes.label: Partial verified commission information
redressModes.publicExplanation: Known commission can be recorded, but additional finance impact and compensatory interest remain lender-only information unless officially provided.

redressModes.label: Official lender figure supplied
redressModes.publicExplanation: The user has entered an official lender figure. The page records it but does not verify or approve the calculation.

calculationLabels: Unable to calculate without more information
